title: He Knew Me First
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Before the world had seen my face,
Before my very start,
Heavenly Father knew my name
And loved me in His heart.

[Chorus]
He says, "Don't say you're just a child,
Go where I send you to;
And never be afraid, because
I'm always here with you."

[Verse 2]
Young Jeremiah looked down low
At his two little hands;
"I'm just a child, I cannot speak."
The Lord had bigger plans.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
When Beau was smallest in his class,
He held the heavy door;
His hands shook, but he held it wide,
And that's what hands are for.

[Chorus]

[Verse 4]
So hold up both your little hands,
And look at them today;
He knew them long before you came,
And He will walk your way.

[Chorus]
mood: Stepping-forward music. A small, steady walking pulse under the voice, like a child taking one brave step and then the next through an open doorway into daylight. A cello holds a low, warm line and a nylon guitar answers it, back and forth, never crowding each other. It starts quiet and a little unsure, then settles into a firm, easy stride by the last verse, plain and bright, nothing hurried.
